title: Midterm 2
instructions:
Ten questions. Most ask you to complete a class; a few are whole programs in `Main.java`. Where a question gives a read-only `Main.java`, you can Run it to try your code.

Print and return exactly what each question asks: spelling, spaces, capital letters and punctuation all count. In a sample run, what the user types is shown in [brackets].

The reference sheet below each question lists the methods you may use.
